scope: Software verification on pinned source. The cold restore next-action assertion was a pending QA change. Production deployment remains separate.

variants.M1.01.04.positive.1: The exact protected build served an authenticated Company create-unit action with a matching row, audit and browser reload.
variants.M1.01.04.invalid_input.1: Invalid configuration and unreachable PostgreSQL stopped startup. The release recorder rejected a mismatched manifest before recording.
variants.M1.01.04.permission_isolation.1: Missing perimeter credentials and the Worker session were denied Admin access.
variants.M1.01.04.retry_recovery.1: The current build recovered from a controlled process failure with the same persisted Worker and Admin sessions.
variants.M1.01.04.persistence.1: Cold PostgreSQL and private object restore retained Worker identity, answer, draft, pinned history and authorized evidence bytes. Foreign access stayed denied.
variants.M1.01.04.downstream_outcome.1: The recovered Worker saw the same case and next action and saved and reread a new draft revision after cold restore. The returned candidate persisted a new Company action.
variants.M1.01.04.retry_recovery.2: Candidate to prior and back retained Company actions, Worker case, audit and private bytes with verified ownership of the active listener.
